display.purpose: Dominant numbers, rare hero moments, and high-emphasis app states.

body.purpose: Readable app copy and form descriptions.

label.purpose: Metadata, table headers, status context, and compact UI labels.

elevationMeta.philosophy: Flexible mix of tonal layering, quiet rings, and tactile shadows based on app need.

motionMeta.themeTransition: View-transition circle reveal around --vt-x and --vt-y, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
motionMeta.defaultDuration: 150ms-300ms for component state, 1000ms for theme view transition.
motionMeta.principle: Animate opacity, transform, and clip-path. Avoid layout-property animation.

button.base: Base UI button plus cva variants, touch-hitbox, rounded-md, compact heights, focus ring.

card.base: Rounded-lg bg-card surface with ring separation and default 1rem vertical rhythm.
card.rule: Use for grouped objects and framed tools, not as the default page layout.

input.base: Compact rounded-md field with border-input, subtle fill, focus ring, disabled and invalid states.

sidebar.base: Inset shadcn sidebar with collapsible icon mode, mobile sheet behavior, and app-provided brand/header composition.

managementTable.base: Responsive overflow table with editorial labels and generous row spacing.

do: Build reusable components on top of @bubbles/ui shadcn primitives.
Keep Catppuccin Latte and Mocha as the default theme spine.
Let individual apps vary density, playfulness, and elevation based on their workflow.
Respect WCAG AA, keyboard access, responsive behavior, and reduced motion.
dont: Do not create card-heavy layouts where every piece of content becomes the same rounded box.
Do not rewrite shadcn primitive files directly unless the reason has been discussed.
Do not drift into generic SaaS dashboards, corporate blue defaults, overdesigned marketing gloss, or decorative complexity.
Do not use side-stripe borders, gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, hero-metric templates, identical card grids, or modal-first interaction design.
